Context: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS  
1. Is it necessary for a Government servant to obtain permission while seeking redress in the Court of law for grievances arising out of their employment or service?  
Permission is not necessary.  
2. What is the special leave provision available to an aggrieved woman during an inquiry on sexual harassment?  
leave up to a maximum of .90 days may be granted in addition to the leave which she is otherwise entitled to.
